title: Digital Overload
description: A surreal painting of a blue-skinned woman with flowing pink hair made of flowers, smartphones, and floating numbers. She points upward with an angry expression while three decomposed figures sit at a wooden desk, their heads replaced by glowing smartphones displaying QR codes and text.
prompt: Surreal painting of a blue-skinned angry woman with elaborate flowing pink hair composed of flowers, old mobile phones, and floating numbers. She points her finger upward with an open mouth. In the foreground, three decaying humanoid figures sit at a wooden desk with their heads replaced by smartphones, one showing a QR code. A ghostly silhouette appears on the pink wall behind them, with flowers and numbers floating throughout the scene.
